summary: The Plane of Time is a nonlinear realm where past, present, and future coexist. Mortals who enter Time confront echoes of history, future possibilities, and temporal guardians.

events: Time formed outside conventional planar structure.
Temporal currents stabilized into distinct phases.
Gods established limited influence over Time.
Temporal guardians arose to maintain cosmic chronology.
Temporal fractures connected Time to Norrath.
Mortals breached Time during the Planes of Power era.
The Throne of Time became accessible through stabilized fractures.
